question_vi: CORS trong Spring Boot cấu hình như thế nào?
question_en: How do you configure CORS in Spring Boot?
answer_html_vi:
CORS — browser chặn request từ origin khác. Spring Boot có nhiều cách config.

Global config (recommended):

java
@Bean
WebMvcConfigurer corsConfig() {
  return new WebMvcConfigurer() {
    @Override public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry reg) {
      reg.addMapping("/api/**")
        .allowedOrigins("https://app.example.com", "http://localhost:3000")
        .allowedMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS")
        .allowCredentials(true).maxAge(3600);
    }
  };
}

Cách khác: @CrossOrigin(origins = "...") trên controller (đơn giản, per-controller). Lưu ý: khi dùng Spring Security, CORS phải cấu hình qua http.cors(...) trong SecurityFilterChain — config WebMvc bị Security filter chặn trước.
answer_html_en:
CORS — browsers block requests from other origins. Spring Boot offers several config options.

Global config (recommended):

java
@Bean
WebMvcConfigurer corsConfig() {
  return new WebMvcConfigurer() {
    @Override public void addCorsMappings(CorsRegistry reg) {
      reg.addMapping("/api/**")
        .allowedOrigins("https://app.example.com", "http://localhost:3000")
        .allowedMethods("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS")
        .allowCredentials(true).maxAge(3600);
    }
  };
}

Alternatives: @CrossOrigin(origins = "...") on a controller (simple, per-controller). Note: with Spring Security, CORS must be configured via http.cors(...) in the SecurityFilterChain — WebMvc-level config is intercepted by the Security filter first.
